units.titles: Potential Exploit Due to Premature and Unauthorized Initialization of Allocation Points
units.known_address_notes: Hacken page: Platform=Base, repo Artist3-NFT/gamic-airdrop @d4020cb (now 404), contracts AirdropVault/Airdrop/Staking. Blockscout Base search found the verified AirdropVault that actually holds GNG (token-balances API), distinguishing it from an unrelated 0xAd0f1eda... vault. Mainnet explorer name search was the only route because the repo and Basescan UI are unavailable (Basescan blocked by Cloudflare; Etherscan V2 free tier rejects chainid 8453, code read via Alchemy).

units.titles: Chained signature with checkpoint usage disabled can bypass all checkpointer validation
units.known_address_notes: Audit scope src/Factory.sol, Stage1Module.sol, Stage2Module.sol, Guest.sol of 0xsequence/wallet-contracts-v3. live-contracts README publishes the sequence_v3/rc_6 row set; addresses are ERC-2470 deterministic and identical across supported EVM chains. Blockscout independently shows the same Stage1Module implementations. Chained-signature/checkpointer logic lives in Stage1Module/Stage2Module.

OtterSec scope file is packages/oracle-aggregator/sources/price.move. Aftermath's published package table names the 'oracle' package 0x923733...; GraphQL confirms modules price/price_feed/source. Config (oracle) object 0xd41beee1... is listed too. The audited oracle-aggregator is the ancestor of this published 'oracle' package.
